concerns.text: Success Criterion SC-001 (Spearman correlation between halo triaxiality and galaxy SFR) has no associated task in tasks.md. No unit test, script, or analysis step is defined to compute or validate this correlation.

Success Criterion SC-005 (computational feasibility within a single GitHub Actions job) is not covered by any task. There is no task that measures, monitors, or asserts the total runtime or memory usage of the full pipeline.
